title: Web Hosting Plans Early Renewal Amount Worksheet
content:
## Worksheet: the early renewal amount (Web Hosting Plans)

| Line | What it is |
|---|---|
| 1. New term length | The current one (the plan's billing term), since a plan with a scheduled term change request is outside this rule. |
| 2. Regular price | The plan tier's regular price for the new term length: the tier's regular 12, 24 or 36-month rate in the Web Hosting Plans price schedule multiplied by the months of that term, or the tier's 1-month price for a 1-month term, with no setup fee. |
| 3. Rounding | The early renewal amount is rounded half up to the cent. |
| 4. Assembly | Credits are fixed amounts in USD that are never discounted: the early renewal amount is the discounted price less the credits, rounded half up to the cent, and the credits together never take more than half of the discounted price. The discounted price is the regular price after the percentage that acts on it, if any, has acted once, rounded half up to the cent before any credit is applied. |

**Worked example (hypothetical rate, not a Harborline price).** A plan on a 36-month billing term whose tier has a hypothetical regular 36-month rate of USD 4.15 per month: the new term is 36 months and the regular price is 4.15 multiplied by 36, USD 149.40. With no credit the early renewal amount is USD 149.40.

**Assembly illustration (hypothetical credits).** Credits of USD 18.30 on a discounted price of USD 149.40 leave USD 131.10. Credits of USD 80.00 are held to half of USD 149.40, USD 74.70, leaving USD 74.70.
